verses.original: לְדָוִ֗ד מַ֫שְׂכִּ֥יל אַשְׁרֵ֥י נְֽשׂוּי־ פֶּ֗שַׁע כְּס֣וּי חֲטָאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ maś·kîl ’aš·rê nə·śui- pe·ša‘ kə·sui ḥă·ṭā·’āh
verses.literal: Of David A Maskil Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven whose sins are covered

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָ֗ם לֹ֤א יַחְשֹׁ֬ב יְהוָ֣ה ל֣וֹ עָוֺ֑ן וְאֵ֖ין בְּרוּח֣וֹ רְמִיָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê ’ā·ḏām lō yaḥ·šōḇ Yah·weh lōw ‘ā·wōn wə·’ên bə·rū·ḥōw rə·mī·yå̄h
verses.literal: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him in whose spirit there is no deceit

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הֶ֭חֱרַשְׁתִּי בָּל֣וּ עֲצָמָ֑י בְּ֝שַׁאֲגָתִ֗י כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- he·ḥĕ·raš·tî bā·lū ‘ă·ṣā·māy bə·ša·’ă·ḡā·ṯî kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: When I kept silent my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long . . .

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַיְלָה֮ תִּכְבַּ֥ד עָלַ֗י יָ֫דֶ֥ךָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְשַׁדִּ֑י בְּחַרְבֹ֖נֵי קַ֣יִץ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî yō·w·mām wā·lay·lāh tiḵ·baḏ ‘ā·lay yā·ḏe·ḵā neh·paḵ lə·šad·dî bə·ḥar·ḇō·nê qa·yiṣ se·lāh
verses.literal: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me my strength was drained as in the summer heat Selah

verses.original: חַטָּאתִ֨י אוֹדִ֪יעֲךָ֡ וַעֲוֺ֘נִ֤י לֹֽא־ כִסִּ֗יתִי אָמַ֗רְתִּי אוֹדֶ֤ה עֲלֵ֣י פְ֭שָׁעַי לַיהוָ֑ה וְאַתָּ֨ה נָ֘שָׂ֤אתָ עֲוֺ֖ן חַטָּאתִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî ’ō·w·ḏî·‘ă·ḵā wa·‘ă·wō·nî lō- ḵis·sî·ṯî ’ā·mar·tî ’ō·w·ḏeh ‘ă·lê p̄ə·šā·‘ay Yah·weh wə·’at·tāh nā·śā·ṯā ‘ă·wōn ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî se·lāh
verses.literal: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity I said I will confess . . . my transgressions to the LORD and You forgave the guilt of my sin Selah

verses.original: עַל־ זֹ֡את יִתְפַּלֵּ֬ל כָּל־ חָסִ֨יד׀ אֵלֶיךָ֮ לְעֵ֪ת מְ֫צֹ֥א רַ֗ק לְ֭שֵׁטֶף מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים אֵ֝לָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- zōṯ yiṯ·pal·lêl kāl- ḥā·sîḏ ’ê·le·ḵā lə·‘êṯ mə·ṣō raq lə·šê·ṭep̄ ma·yim rab·bîm ’ê·lāw lō yag·gî·‘ū
verses.literal: Therefore . . . let all the godly pray to You while You may be found Surely when great . . . waters rise they will not come near

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה׀ סֵ֥תֶר לִי֮ מִצַּ֪ר תִּ֫צְּרֵ֥נִי רָנֵּ֥י פַלֵּ֑ט תְּס֖וֹבְבֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh sê·ṯer lî miṣ·ṣar tiṣ·ṣə·rê·nî rān·nê p̄al·lêṭ tə·sō·wḇ·ḇê·nî se·lāh
verses.literal: You are my hiding place You protect me from trouble You surround me with songs of deliverance Selah

verses.original: אַשְׂכִּֽילְךָ֨׀ וְֽאוֹרְךָ֗ בְּדֶֽרֶךְ־ ז֥וּ תֵלֵ֑ךְ אִֽיעֲצָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יךָ עֵינִֽי׃
verses.literal: I will instruct you and teach you the way . . . you should go I will give you counsel and watch over you

verses.original: אַל־ תִּֽהְי֤וּ׀ כְּס֥וּס כְּפֶרֶד֮ אֵ֤ין הָ֫בִ֥ין בְּמֶֽתֶג־ וָרֶ֣סֶן עֶדְי֣וֹ לִבְל֑וֹם בַּ֝֗ל קְרֹ֣ב אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tih·yū kə·sūs kə·p̄e·reḏ ’ên hā·ḇîn bə·me·ṯeḡ- wā·re·sen ‘eḏ·yōw liḇ·lō·wm bal qə·rōḇ ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not be like the horse or mule which have no understanding they must be controlled with bit and bridle . . . to make them come to you

verses.original: רַבִּ֥ים מַכְאוֹבִ֗ים לָרָ֫שָׁ֥ע וְהַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה חֶ֝֗סֶד יְסוֹבְבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bîm maḵ·’ō·w·ḇîm lā·rā·šā‘ wə·hab·bō·w·ṭê·aḥ Yah·weh ḥe·seḏ yə·sō·wḇ·ḇen·nū
verses.literal: Many are the sorrows of the wicked but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD

verses.original: שִׂמְח֬וּ בַֽיהוָ֣ה וְ֭גִילוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝הַרְנִ֗ינוּ כָּל־ יִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: śim·ḥū Yah·weh wə·ḡî·lū ṣad·dî·qîm wə·har·nî·nū kāl- yiš·rê- lêḇ
verses.literal: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice O righteous ones shout for joy all you upright in heart
